title: B5: Fix hero title clipping in RecipeHeroHeader.swift
description: Refactor RecipeHeroHeader.swift so the hero container has a fixed height (~260 pt) applied unconditionally to both the real-image and the placeholder-block paths, eliminating layout differences between the two cases. Apply .scaledToFill().frame(height: fixed).clipped() on the image so it never bleeds beyond the container. Anchor the title text overlay to the container's bottom-leading edge using .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) with .padding(.horizontal) and .padding(.bottom, ~12–16 pt). Add a LinearGradient (clear → Color.black.opacity(0.6)) covering ~40 % of the container bottom for legibility. Title typography: .title or .title2.bold() (dev agent's choice). Dismiss X button position (top-leading) is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Hero container has a fixed height (~260 pt) enforced regardless of image vs placeholder path
Title overlay uses .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) on the container with horizontal and bottom padding
LinearGradient (clear → black.opacity(0.6)) covers ~40 % of the container bottom
Dismiss X button remains at top-leading
Placeholder no-image case still renders correctly and the layout is identical in both paths

handoff_summary.completed: All acceptance criteria met: fixed 260 pt height enforced on both paths; image uses scaledToFill+frame(height)+clipped; title uses overlay(bottomLeading) with separate padding; gradient covers ~40% of bottom; dismiss button unchanged at top-leading; placeholder path renders identically.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. The structural change from ZStack-based to overlay-based composition is strictly an internal layout detail; no public API or model types were touched.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for UI snapshot / layout verification of both the real-image and placeholder paths.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No other beads in this feature touch RecipeHeroHeader.swift; no conflict risk.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Chose .title2.bold() over .title per spec option; chose 14 pt bottom padding (within the 12-16 pt range); gradient uses .frame(height: heroHeight * 0.4) at .bottom alignment rather than a startPoint tweak to achieve clean 40% coverage.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written — tester agent should verify hero renders at exactly 260 pt in both image and placeholder states, title is visible and not clipped, gradient covers only the bottom 40%, and dismiss button sits at top-leading.

conflict_risks: No other beads in this feature touch RecipeHeroHeader.swift; no conflict risk.

execution_history.summary: Refactored RecipeHeroHeader.swift: fixed hero height to 260 pt on both image and placeholder paths, applied .scaledToFill().frame(height:).clipped() on the image, moved title to .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) with horizontal and 14 pt bottom padding, scoped gradient to 40% of container height via .overlay(alignment: .bottom), and kept dismiss X at top-leading. Build passes cleanly.
